scientific_integrity: Same-model proof reconstruction and numerical corroboration; historical priority remains provisional; Euclidean flat special case and earlier polar geometry are credited.
scientific_limitations: Fixed disk radius and curvature before taking the endpoint limit; space forms of curvature at most zero only; no stability under observational noise, no uniform parameter limit, no independent mathematical/historical audit.
title: Sharp near-diameter geodesic tails and curvature recovery for constant-curvature disks
